description: This PHP source file defines the AOR_Scheduled_Reports class, which extends a base class 'basic'. It manages scheduled report configurations within the SuiteCRM system, including report scheduling, email recipient management, and execution logic based on cron schedules. The class also contains methods for retrieving email recipients, determining if a report should run, and processing recipient data.

classes.name: AOR_Scheduled_Reports
classes.description: Represents a scheduled report entity within SuiteCRM, managing report schedule, recipients, and execution logic.

methods.description: Indicates interface implementations for this bean; returns true for 'ACL'.

methods.description: Overrides parent save method to parse recipients before saving.

methods.name: get_email_recipients
methods.description: Retrieves email recipients based on serialized configuration, resolving user and group IDs into email addresses.

methods.name: shouldRun
methods.description: Determines whether the scheduled report should run at the given DateTime, based on the cron schedule.

methods.name: handleTimeZone
methods.description: Adjusts a DateTime object for the configured timezone offset.

methods.description: Parses email recipient data from POST request and serializes it for storage.
